summary.root_cause_text: Ops config change switched payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration), which is unreachable; worker marked orders processed without payment, failures logged only at DEBUG.
recommended: Verify payments-v2 endpoint reachability before retrying the migration
Alert on provider call failures (raise from DEBUG to ERROR)
Don't mark orders processed when payment fails
